name: Thick Hide
description: Tough skin reduces all damage taken by 10%.

name: Quick Reflexes
description: 10% chance to dodge any attack.

name: Second Wind
description: The first time HP drops below 50%, restores 15% of max HP.

name: Opening Strike
description: Deals 20% more damage on its first action.

name: Stubborn
description: Below 50% HP, takes 20% less damage.

name: Momentum
description: Speed increased by 15%.

name: Spiteful Thorns
description: Returns 10% of the damage taken to the attacker.

name: Lullaby
description: Its attacks have a 15% chance to put the opponent to sleep for one action.

name: Lucid Shift
description: While above 50% HP, has a 20% chance to dodge attacks.

name: Resonance
description: Its attacks resonate, dealing 15% more damage.

name: Feedback
description: Returns 20% of the damage taken as a painful echo.

name: Rewind
description: The first time HP drops below 50%, rewinds its wounds restoring 25% of max HP.

name: Haste
description: Speed increased by 25% on its first action.

name: Heavy Body
description: Its immense density reduces all damage taken by 20%.

name: Crushing Pull
description: Deals 25% more damage to faster opponents.

name: Muffle
description: Smothers the opponent at the start, reducing its attack by 15%.

name: Unseen
description: 25% chance to dodge the first attack it receives.

name: Recall
description: Remembers every wound: below 50% HP deals 20% more damage.

name: Imprint
description: Has learned from the past: element disadvantage has no effect on it.

name: Entropy
description: At every action, a random stat is increased by 30%.

name: Wild Surge
description: Below 50% HP, chaos takes over: deals 40% more damage.

name: Dreamweaver
description: Its attacks have a 35% chance to trap the opponent in a dream for one action.

name: Endless Chorus
description: Every blow it receives echoes back: returns 40% of the damage taken.

name: Hourglass Reversal
description: Once per encounter, when defeated, turns back time and returns with 50% HP.

name: Event Horizon
description: Attacks bend around it: all damage taken is reduced by 40%.

name: Absolute Quiet
description: Imposes total silence: the opponent's attack is reduced by 35%.

name: Eternal Archive
description: Reads the opponent's past and copies its ability for the rest of the encounter.

name: Paradox Engine
description: Breaks the rules: element advantages are reversed for the whole encounter.
